rules.anchor_quote:
This act shall take effect on the first day of
the twelfth month next following the date of enactment.
rules.coverage_text: All rental residential dwelling units and owners in New Jersey, excluding inpatient, long-term care and detention facilities.
rules.effective_expression: first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment

exemptions.description: Government entity setting or limiting rents through affordability controls
exemptions.quote:
“Coordinator” shall not include a government entity that sets or limits rents
or sale prices of residential property through affordability controls in
accordance with law.

rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act; sections 6 through 17 of P.L.1970, c.73 remain applicable
rules.quote:
It
shall be unlawful and a violation of the “New Jersey Antitrust Act,” P.L.1970,
c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for:
a.     a rental property owner, or any agent,
representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract
for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of,
the services of a coordinator;
relations_hint:
A municipality shall be prohibited from enacting
an ordinance that conflicts with this act.
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for rental property owners to use a coordinator's services, for coordinators to facilitate anticompetitive agreements or perform a coordinating function, or for persons to engage in parallel pricing coordination. Violations are violations of the New Jersey Antitrust Act.
rules.title: Ban on algorithmic rent coordination
